violated_contract: A persisted policy snapshot must be resolved from the serving role's configuration. An operator process (a script on a laptop or VM) that reaches a resolve-on-first-claim path must not resolve and persist the snapshot from its own environment: it must reuse the stored snapshot, take the serving role's live settings explicitly, or refuse the unit before any write. On 2026-10-20, batch_pipeline_policy.stage_in_transaction resolved an unpinned unit's recovery part from os.environ, and the held-unit speech redrive, silence disposition and terminal-empty operator paths all reached it, so an operator run could write its laptop settings into prod batch jobs.
canonical_prevention: Policy resolution helpers take an explicit server-settings argument whose default means 'this process is the serving role'. Operator-only stores and entrypoints require that argument with no default (None refuses an unpinned unit), so a new operator caller cannot silently inherit its own environment.
